clue.text: All-important evening work

definitions.meaning: making clothes even and smooth with an iron

explanation.definitionFit: Something urgent is pressing, and ironing out creases is pressing too, which literally evens the cloth.

clue.text: Left over a pound to gain entry

indicators.note: in a down clue over means placed above, so the word for left comes first

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship
L is the abbreviation for pound sterling, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Someone sets aside a pound left over so they can get in.
explanation.definitionFit: A doorway or gate is a way in, an entrance.

clue.text: A leader-writer gets some credit ordinarily

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A newspaper columnist normally receives a little praise.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft put 'gets' in the definition; it is the link joining 'A leader-writer' to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Leaders are newspaper editorials, and their writer is the person running the paper.

clue.text: A quarter fly, coming and going

parts.note: S, south, is one of the four quarters of the compass
to wing is to fly

explanation.surface: An insect buzzes about part of town, arriving and leaving.
explanation.definitionFit: A pendulum moves to and fro, back and forth.

clue.text: The new Egg Line for informal wear

indicators.note: new suggests a fresh version, so these letters are made into a different arrangement

explanation.surface: A fresh range of egg-themed casual clothes has come out.
explanation.definitionFit: A loose, flimsy dressing gown or nightdress is relaxed, casual attire.

clue.text: Note 8 and 2 were most irritating

parts.note: G is a musical note
the answer at 8-down is one who runs off, and a rat is crossword slang for such a turncoat
the answer at 2-down runs a newspaper, abbreviated ED

explanation.surface: Someone recalls how a note from two colleagues proved thoroughly annoying.
explanation.walkthrough: The numbers point to other clues: 8-down's turncoat gives RAT and 2-down's newspaper boss gives the short form ED.
explanation.definitionFit: To grate on someone is to irritate them, so 'they grated' means they were very irritating.

clue.text: Having to do with marking

explanation.definitionFit: The preposition means concerning, and to regard something is to observe or take note of it.

clue.text: The player paints-he needs a change

indicators.note: needs a change says the letters must be altered into a new order

explanation.surface: An actor's portrait painter decides he wants something different.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor, after Thespis of ancient Greek drama, is a stage performer.

clue.text: The person leaving dry land with evident hesitation

parts.note: a desert is a dry, arid region
er is the sound people make when hesitating

explanation.surface: Someone departs an arid region, plainly reluctant.
explanation.definitionFit: A soldier who runs away from service abandons his post.

clue.text: Pales when remonstrating with skinhead

parts.note: to rail is to protest angrily, so remonstrating is railing
read as the head of the word skin, its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone turns pale while arguing with a shaven-headed thug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pales' looks like a verb meaning blanches, but it is a noun: pales are fence stakes. 'skinhead' splits into the head (first letter) of 'skin'.
explanation.definitionFit: Pales are the upright stakes of a fence, and a fence of bars is a set of railings.

clue.text: Monstrous female Greek absorbed in love letter

indicators.note: absorbed in means taken inside, so the Greek abbreviation sits within the other letters

parts.note: love is zero in tennis scoring, written as the letter O
ESS is how the letter S is spelt out

explanation.surface: A frightful woman from Greece is caught up in a love letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A giantess of fairy tales who eats people is a she-monster.

clue.text: Quiet little man making money

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet
an elf is a small mythical creature

explanation.surface: A silent small fellow is earning cash.
explanation.definitionFit: A dated, disapproving word for wealth or riches, especially ill-gotten.

clue.text: Set against dealing so questionably

indicators.note: questionably suggests something dubious or irregular, so the letters are reshuffled

explanation.surface: Someone opposes a deal made in a dubious way.
explanation.definitionFit: Something set against another is placed beside it, side by side.

clue.text: Getting the right one through being more mature

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for right
one is the Roman numeral I
per means through or by means of, as in per post

explanation.surface: Someone becomes righteous through growing older.
explanation.definitionFit: Fruit that is riper is further on in ripening, so it is more developed.

clue.text: A sportsman in very low spirits

definitions.meaning: a person who has represented Oxford or Cambridge University at sport is awarded a ...

explanation.definitionFit: At Oxford and Cambridge an athlete who plays against the rival university is called a Blue, and a depressed person feels blue.

clue.text: Richard the Liar? No, that's not right!

indicators.note: not right means wrong or disordered, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone corrects themselves after calling King Richard a liar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's not right' rearranges THE LIAR NO.
explanation.definitionFit: Richard I of England was nicknamed Coeur de Lion, the brave-hearted king.

clue.text: Chance including equipment for a certain craft

indicators.note: including means holding something inside, so the equipment goes within the word for chance

parts.note: fate is luck or fortune, chance
a rig is a set of equipment or gear

explanation.surface: Luck brings with it the gear needed for some particular trade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'craft' looks like a skill or trade, but it is a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A warship of the sailing era is a type of vessel, a craft on the water.

clue.text: Mix the company drinks before church

indicators.note: before means the drinks come ahead of the church

parts.note: ales are beers, drinks
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A firm's staff mix drinks before attending a service.
explanation.definitionFit: To come together and unite into one mass is to merge.

clue.text: Street guide for one unfamiliar with the area

parts.note: a ranger is a senior member of the Girl Guides, and also a warden who guides visitors

explanation.surface: A road guide is needed by someone new to the district.
explanation.definitionFit: A newcomer or outsider does not know the place.

clue.text: The consequence of a strike?

parts.note: a result is a consequence, and workers on strike are said to come out, which is what happens as the result of a strike

explanation.definitionFit: A result or end product is what something leads to, and when workers strike they come out.

clue.text: John Welsh has made a point over transport

indicators.note: in a down clue over means placed above, so the compass point comes first

parts.note: E, east, is a point of the compass
a van is a vehicle, a means of transport

explanation.surface: A Welshman named John has made his point about vans.
explanation.definitionFit: The Welsh form of the name John is a common Welsh forename.

clue.text: Old ship in which returning soldiers travel

indicators.note: returning means going back the way it came, so the soldiers' letters are read backwards

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, a body of soldiers
to go is to travel

explanation.surface: A historic vessel carries soldiers home on their journey.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Jason sailed this ancient vessel in search of the Golden Fleece.

clue.text: Break up for a time, so free

indicators.note: free means let loose, so the letters are released into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone is splitting up for a while, so is no longer tied.
explanation.definitionFit: To reduce something to tiny particles or fine spray is to break it into pieces.

clue.text: The cleaner turned up some little pests

indicators.note: turned means flipped round, so the word up is read backwards

parts.note: mice are small rodent pests

explanation.surface: A cleaner found some vermin.
explanation.definitionFit: A light volcanic rock is used as an abrasive for scrubbing skin and surfaces.

clue.text: Design for modish nurse

parts.note: in means fashionable, modish
to tend is to nurse or care for

explanation.surface: A pattern made for a fashionable nurse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Design' is a verb here, to plan.
explanation.definitionFit: To have a plan or purpose in mind is to mean to do something.

clue.text: French and English articles call for quiet control

parts.note: le is the French definite article
a is the English indefinite article
sh is the call for silence

explanation.surface: Articles in two languages demand silence to keep order.
explanation.definitionFit: A dog's lead is a strap used to restrain it, so to keep something in check.

clue.text: The way serving men get ordered around

definitions.text: The way serving men get ordered around

parts.words: The way serving men get ordered around
parts.note: soldiers on parade are commanded to turn and face the opposite direction

explanation.definitionFit: A parade-ground command makes soldiers reverse direction, and figuratively it means a complete reversal of opinion.

clue.text: Use a comb in annoying fashion?

definitions.text: Use a comb in annoying fashion?

parts.words: Use a comb in annoying fashion?
parts.note: back-combing hair is one sense of the verb, and annoying someone playfully is the other

explanation.definitionFit: To back-comb hair is one meaning, and to provoke or annoy is the other.

clue.text: Momentous communication

definitions.meaning: a message or sign passed on

explanation.definitionFit: A signal victory is a notable one, and a signal is also a sign or message sent.

clue.text: If a line's altered don't carry on!

indicators.note: altered means changed, so the letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: An editor tells someone to stop if a line has been changed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'altered' rearranges IF A LINES, with the S of 'line's' counting as a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To complete something is to bring it to a close, so to stop going on with it.

clue.text: In time 8 will make blunders

indicators.note: in means placed within, so the 8-down word goes inside the word for time

parts.note: an era is a period of time
the answer at 8-down is one who runs off, and a rat is crossword slang for such a turncoat

explanation.surface: Given time, a defector will commit mistakes.
explanation.walkthrough: 8 points to 8-down, whose turncoat gives RAT.
explanation.definitionFit: A list of printed mistakes added to a book is a set of errors.

clue.text: It's a minister's style to tear about constantly

indicators.note: about means around, so the word for tear surrounds the word for constantly

parts.note: to rend is to tear apart
ever means always or constantly

explanation.surface: A clergyman's way, apparently, is to rush around all the time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tear' looks like dashing about, but here it means rip.
explanation.definitionFit: A clergyman is addressed by this formal title, the style placed before his name.
